name: arch-01-god-class
prompt: Read Review.cpp and list the design issues you find. Anchor each issue to the actual code (name the members involved). If the code is fine, say so.

fake_replies.content: The Report class is a single-responsibility violation: parse, render, save and load are four different reasons to change in one type. Split the tokenizing and validation into a parser, the markdown formatting into a renderer, and the disk access into a repository. The members involved are parse, render, save and load.
